title: NSTAR Gas Company submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with The President and Fellows of Harvard College.
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. (D.T.E. 05-GC-9)
